“It hungers to sink teeth into problems.”
–Loup
Was it something you ate?
Destruction is an art.
Subtlety is a luxury.

–René “Loup” Arcemont
The greediest bloodsucker this side of a corporate boardroom.

“It waits on an unlabelled memstrip far below the deepest hab. Angry, desperate souls seek it out, hungry for power to change a brutal world. Once they can stomach no more bitter revenge, they return to that nameless tunnel, the book a recipe thicker.”
–Heinlein urban legend
I obtain your desire.
The real reward is the friends you make along the way.

“A mirrorfiber mod or high-end mantle can be helpful, but nothing beats a good dose of ‘keeping your damn head down.’”
–“G0ph3r” OʼRyan

“Braggarts chase big heists. Patience enriches skimming fractions of a credit at a time.” –Zahya

The whole wide world your domain
For law your own free will.

–Zahya Sadeghi
Shhhh. Itʼs naptime.

Sufficient skill is indistinguishable from magic.
The challenge of my art is what I live for, but Iʼm not going to say no to a patron with taste.

“You know thereʼs no water in the Sea of Tranquility, right?”
“That doesnʼt mean thereʼs no beach.”

“With this beautiful baby I can juggle simultaneous runs by haptic feedback alone!”
–Tāo

A dabbling with truth is a pernicious dream

The beauty of open projects—each stands atop past success.
The joy of handcrafted code—each fits perfectly within the whole.

“For all I know, I could spend a shift digging next to old Weyland himself.”
–Lane

“Weʼll take the access codes from their own prisec—privilege escalation through local application of force.”
–The Catalyst

Anyone can put in the hours of planning, practice, and preparation–but making it all look like luck takes style.
LLDS still holds the patent, but good tech attracts knockoffs.
Compiling even the smallest AI takes weeks for only seconds of runtime, but that brief, shining moment allows… everything.
The beauty of 22nd-century tech: if it still functions after all these decades, you know the build quality is solid.

“Some kids got g-mods for beauty, sports, or staying up all night. My parents thought Broca-mods were cool. Hah. Fluent in ten languages so far, and still searching for the words to thank them.”
–Patrick Blue, Solar Artist

–Do Nhi Minh
All time is crunch time.

“Whose memory-tape needs such stringent security?”
–The Catalyst
An End to Suffering.
We make you anew.

It reads your future in a single biometric sweep.
You did not escape, you were shown mercy.

“Constant self-reflection is the key to excellence. We remember failed ideas, but do not carry them forward.”
–Director Kase, unknown leadership seminar
Macroscale developments within the Net decouple the prior informational states–surplus entropy is then gifted where it will do the most good.

–Conceptual Frameworks for Applied Theology
